title: Staff Quick Start
sub: Four pages for the adults who run the plan every day, read once before the first day and kept at hand: who the student is and where things stand, the few things that matter most, why the behavior happens, a day with the student, how to talk, the skills already there, tier by tier what you see, do and say, the non-negotiables, what to record, the first weeks, and who to call; with a one-glance flow sheet. Filled from the case as a starting point, every line marked until you have rewritten it in the words your staff use.
